title: Kestrel Vehicle Program Entry Standards for Listed Vehicles
content:
Each vehicle sold under Vehicle Purchase Agreements is listed under one of six Kestrel vehicle programs, from lowest to highest rank: Kestrel Value Line, Kestrel Inspected, Kestrel Certified, Kestrel Certified Plus, Kestrel Premium Certified and Kestrel Factory Certified. A program's entry standards describe the vehicles it lists.

| Vehicle program | Odometer at listing | Model age | Inspection points passed | Other standards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | at least 100000 miles, or model age at least 10 years (either qualifies) | no separate limit | 150 | no branded title |
| Kestrel Inspected | at most 99999 miles | at most 9 years | 150 | no branded title |
| Kestrel Certified | at most 75000 miles | at most 7 years | 172 | no branded title; no structural, frame or airbag-deployment damage reported |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | at most 45000 miles | at most 4 years | 172 | no branded title; no accident reported; at most 1 previous owner |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | at most 60000 miles | at most 6 years | 200 | no branded title; no structural, frame or airbag-deployment damage reported; make is one of Acura, Audi, BMW, Genesis, Infiniti, Lexus, Lincoln, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche or Volvo |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | at most 80000 miles | at most 6 years | manufacturer certified pre-owned checklist passed | no branded title; manufacturer certified pre-owned warranty registered |

**Model age for Kestrel Value Line.** Model age is the reservation calendar year less the model year. A vehicle with 88000 miles qualifies for Kestrel Value Line when its model year is ten or more years before the reservation calendar year; a vehicle with 100000 miles qualifies whatever its model year.
